_comment: Availability manifest for the OPTIONAL ONNX accelerators. Read by restorer.js and classifier.js before they touch onnxruntime-web. A stock install ships with all three false: the app is fully functional on the classical path and makes no network requests for the model. To enable the model path, vendor onnxruntime-web into app/vendor/ort/, copy the exported .onnx files and tokenizer.json into app/models/, then set the flags to true and bump the sw.js VERSION.
